mentions.name: Bossanova
mentions.description: This app is a session manager for Claude Code and Codex that adds automation and orchestration features. It provides a lightweight terminal UI for controlling coding agent chat sessions from a remote browser, surfaces questions from multiple agents at once, and runs cron jobs for automation. It supports sharing remote coding sessions between team members, auto-repairing PRs, auto-rotating subscription accounts, messaging between chat sessions and across model providers, GitHub callbacks so agents respond to CI events in realtime, and running agents on a Mac mini controlled from a phone. The goal is to organize chat sessions and give agents primitives to communicate with each other across sessions, providers, and networks.
mentions.audience: Some friends and colleagues have started using it, alongside the author's own use.
